title: Exercise in pregnancy
claims: NHS recommends aiming for 150 minutes of moderate-intensity activity per week in pregnancy, including muscle strengthening exercises; moderate activity means you should be able to talk but not sing.
It is not recommended to start a new vigorous activity in pregnancy, such as running.
Sports or activities with a risk of falling or being hit in the abdomen should be avoided; in later pregnancy, avoid lying flat on the back for more than a few minutes.
Drink water to stay hydrated, keep cool, tell the instructor you are pregnant, and stop if you feel uncomfortable, too hot or unwell.
